title: Complete gadget trichotomy for parity decision-tree lifting

standard_prerequisites.name: Boolean affine-subspace closure characterization
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Chen2009 Theorem4.3; exact used source Proposition5.13 retained

standard_prerequisites.name: Polynomial certificate/decision-tree relations, including parity variants
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Beals etal.2001 and Zhang/Shi2010; exact used relations retained in final proof

core_obligations: Obtain large minimum-weight parity certificates by blockwise restriction.
Prove cubic certificate lifting for OR with complete Gaussian-elimination and opposite-certificate arguments.
Classify gadgets by affine AND/OR projections and combine simulation lower bounds with explicit nonlifting families.
difficulty_reason: The authors combine minimum-weight control of affine certificates, careful elimination with twin input variables, an opposite-certificate induction and affine-gadget classification to distinguish three qualitatively different parity-lifting regimes.

dedup.scope: Actual journal DOI and CCC/ECCC aliases absent in existing snapshots and root active-line checks. Independent parity decision-tree depth/size trichotomy, with a different affine-gadget classification from ordinary decision trees and conjunction DAGs. Minimum-weight and OR support lemmas are not separately counted.

compared.difference: Parity/affine gadgets lead to three regimes instead of ordinary weak-resistance dichotomy.
Gadget classification versus a specific log-rank communication subclass.
